projectDescription: A static single-page e-commerce website for AuraStyle, a fictional fashion clothing store offering a Spring/Summer collection with product listings and a contact form.
keyFeatures: Single-page responsive layout using Tailwind CSS
Product catalog with 4 items (Vestido Negro, Camisa Negra, Abrigo de Invierno, Gafas de Sol Premium)
Team/About section with 5 team member profiles
Contact form with mailto action (name, email, WhatsApp, gender, CV upload)
Fixed navigation bar with smooth anchor links
Spring/Summer collection hero section with 3% discount promotion
publicApiSurface: index.html — main entry point with all sections (inicio, nosotros, productos, contacto)
Product cards: Vestido Negro ($59.99), Camisa Negra ($42.00), Abrigo de invierno ($89.99), Gafas de Sol Premium ($69.99)
